title: Reel 2: Creole words and dances before kalenda and bamboula
summary: Reel 2 opens with Creole words; she discusses polka, mazurka and quadrille, kalenda as a song, and the African bamboula dance.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
